title: Governance Control Plane (Layer 0) — central scope/ROE/approvals/credentials/sandbox/budget API + Docker isolation per tool
goal: Consolidate verspreide scope/ROE/approval/credential/sandbox/budget checks into one central Layer 0 Governance Control Plane (per Codex 6-layer architectuur). Every agent decision and runner dispatch validates through this single API. ADDITIONALLY: Docker isolation per exec_plan execution (heavy isolation per PentAGI pattern) so escape risk cannot reach host. No agent bypasses Layer 0.
scope: (1) New `api/app/governance/` module with `control_plane.py`: single class GovernanceControlPlane with methods authorize_dispatch(run, runner, target, tier), authorize_credential_use(run, cred_id), authorize_external_network(run, target), authorize_exec_plan_step(run, step), check_budget(run). All return DispatchAuthorization dataclass with allow/deny/needs_approval. (2) Refactor: replace verspreide approval checks in assessment_loop.py + ai_action_selector.py + workers/orchestration/tasks.py with calls to GovernanceControlPlane. (3) Docker isolation: workers/orchestration/sandbox_runner.py NEW — runs exec_plan steps in fresh Docker container per step (gVisor-isolated if gVisor available, plain Docker otherwise). Container teardown mandatory.
generation_reason: Per Codex 6-layer architectuur: Layer 0 Governance wraps everything. Currently AegisPT has approval checks verspreid over 4+ files (assessment_loop, ai_action_selector, ai_agent, workers/orchestration). Per OpenClaw architectuur (research 2026-05-20): tiered permissions (agent + sandbox + network) zijn niet-onderhandelbaar voor productie. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 2: this task replaces existing verspreide code; old approval checks MUST be removed in same commit.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md AND ANTI_DRIFT.md is loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Three coordinated edits: control_plane module + refactor of 3 caller sites + sandbox_runner. Do NOT add new approval semantics; only centralize existing ones. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 3: REMOVE the verspreide approval code in same commit (no parallel coexistence).
constraints.no_bypass: No agent / runner / picker code path may execute a dispatch without authorize_dispatch() returning allow=True. Greppable test verifies every dispatch site routes through control_plane.
constraints.isolation_default_deny: sandbox_runner default-deny on container network egress. Allowlist must be explicit per engagement scope. Per OpenClaw lessons: deny by default + explicit allowlist.

success_criteria: Metric: 100% of dispatch decisions route through GovernanceControlPlane.authorize_dispatch() (verified via grep + unit test).
Metric: verspreide approval-check code lines REMOVED (cite git diff line-count for deletions).
Metric: all exec_plan steps run in isolated Docker container; 0 host-process executions of exec_plan steps (verified via process tree assertion in test).
Metric: greppable test passes — no direct approval logic outside governance/ module in production code.
Source-grep sentinel: `assessment_loop.py` calls `control_plane.authorize_dispatch(...)` ≥1 time AND `ai_action_selector.py` calls `control_plane.authorize_dispatch(...)` ≥1 time.
Non-autonomous regression: a run with autonomous_intrusive_allowed=False still produces APPROVAL via control_plane (regression test).
Network egress default-deny: test that container without explicit allowlist cannot reach external IPs.
Live (XBOW harness): authorize_dispatch traces visible in Langfuse (per backlog-407 instrumentation); ≥1 challenge solved via sandboxed exec_plan.
must_not_touch: Runner-internal logic (only their dispatch entry point routes through control_plane)
